metadata.analysis: Project Nephele - Timeline of Life's Origin
metadata.author: Carl Zimmerman

fast_start_paradox.paradox_statement: Life appears within ~120-900 Myr of habitability. This is surprisingly fast for a process thought to be improbable.

interpretation_1.name: Abiogenesis is Easy
interpretation_1.description: Given the right conditions, life emerges quickly
problems: Why don't we see second genesis?
Lab experiments don't create life easily

interpretation_2.name: Soft Panspermia
interpretation_2.description: Building blocks arrive from space, reducing time needed

interpretation_3.name: Life Predates Earth
interpretation_3.description: Simple life formed in space, seeded Earth
problems: No direct evidence of space life

interpretation_4.name: Observer Selection Bias
interpretation_4.description: We can only observe universes where life started fast

chiral_seeding_timeline.key_insight: Chirality can be SEEDED in space (cosmic rays + amino acids), but AMPLIFICATION requires liquid water (Frank model). The magma ocean RESETS any pre-existing chirality.
chiral_seeding_timeline.critical_question: Can chiral seeds survive the magma ocean phase, or must chirality be re-seeded on the cool crust?

conclusion.implication: The magma ocean RESETS prebiotic chemistry. Any organics from the protoplanetary disk are destroyed. Earth's organic inventory must be rebuilt via: (1) late meteorite delivery after cool-down, (2) in-situ synthesis from inorganics, (3) or both.
conclusion.explanation: Soft panspermia still works because meteorites continue to deliver organics AFTER the magma ocean cools. The 'late veneer' of meteoritic material is well-documented.

late_delivery.conclusion: Late meteorite delivery could have provided ~7.0e+18 kg of organic material to early Earth, including ~7.0e+16 kg of amino acids. This is a substantial supply of prebiotic material.

chirality_from_late_delivery.implication: If late delivery amino acids had ~1% ee (like Murchison), this provides the initial seed for Frank amplification.

synthesis.question: Could life have originated before Earth was habitable?
explanation: - Amino acids, nucleobases form in protoplanetary disk
- Chirality can be seeded via cosmic rays (validated)
2. BUT the magma ocean RESETS everything:
- These carry chiral seeds (~1% ee in Murchison)
synthesis.key_insight: The Z² framework (via Project Protogonos) shows cosmic rays can seed chirality in space. This chirality is delivered via meteorites AFTER the magma ocean cools. Earth then provides the liquid water needed for Frank autocatalysis to amplify chirality to homochirality. Thus, life's INGREDIENTS come from space, but ASSEMBLY happens on Earth.

ultrathink_status: GREEN - Soft panspermia supported, mechanisms validated
